# Rivora

> Full-stack web development, VPS deployment, and ready-made digital products.

Rivora is a solo full-stack development studio offering custom web applications, production VPS deployment, and pre-built SaaS products.

## Services

- Full-stack web development (Next.js, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL)
- VPS deployment (Docker, Nginx, SSL, monitoring)
- Maintenance and ongoing support
- Technical consulting and architecture
- API development and third-party integrations
- Ready-made products (landing kits, admin panels, SaaS boilerplates)
